verdict.rationale: Veriff's public API uses version-prefixed endpoints such as /v1/sessions, and its docs are organized under a v1 section, so API versioning exists. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or how the API moves between versions. The Android SDK migration guide covers SDK versions, not API deprecation, so it is not credited. missing for 10: documented API deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset timelines, API changelog or version-migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
